Quick Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Tech Hub located in Godhra?

Tech Hub is at Near Prime Bank, Nava Bazar, Godhra, Panchmahal, Gujarat 389001. We are open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM, and on Sundays by prior appointment.

Do you sell certified refurbished laptops in Godhra?

Yes. We sell Grade-A certified refurbished business laptops, including Lenovo ThinkPad, Dell Latitude, HP EliteBook and Apple MacBook. Every refurbished laptop passes a 32-point quality check covering battery health, thermal stress, SSD speed, ports, hinges and display.

Do you provide GST bills?

Yes. We provide proper GST tax invoices with serial number tracking for businesses, CAs, schools, clinics and individual buyers claiming GST input credit.

Can you build a custom desktop for Tally, office or CAD work?

Yes. We build custom and office desktops in Godhra, including Tally and billing PCs, AutoCAD and creator workstations, and compact mini PCs. We also handle bulk orders of 5 or more systems for schools, labs and offices.

Can I upgrade RAM or SSD, or exchange my old laptop?

Yes. We can upgrade RAM (up to 64GB) and NVMe SSD (up to 2TB) on the spot, and you can exchange your old working laptop for upgrade value.

How do I get a price for a laptop or desktop?

Tap Get Estimate on any product, use the Request a Callback form, or call +91 99743 40753. Our team shares an estimate on WhatsApp.

What is the Tech Hub Grand Opening offer?

Tech Hub opens on December 4, 2026 at Near Prime Bank, Nava Bazar, Godhra. Claim a QR offer pass on our website for Flat Rs. 500 off on a minimum purchase of Rs. 5,000 or more, valid December 4 to December 7, 2026. Terms apply.
